premises.text: In-car technology goes outdated quickly and cannot be upgraded without buying a new car, leaving over a billion existing vehicles behind OEM smart-car efforts
premises.evidence_span: aren't you afraid that a year from now, this technology will be completely outdated, and the only way to change that is to buy a new car

premises.text: A plug-in connected-car device and platform make post-1996 cars smarter with an app catalog usable from day one
premises.evidence_span: The VINLY platform uses this small device to connect and communicate with your car

premises.text: Consumer hardware is sold at fixed price tiers for basic and complete devices
premises.evidence_span: $49.99 for our vinly basic device, at $149.99 for our vinly complete

premises.text: Enterprises can plug the same devices into fleets and run business apps including customizable fleet tracking on a per-year device-and-data price
premises.evidence_span: companies can buy Vinly devices, plug it into their fleet, and start using business applications

premises.text: Developers can build connected-car apps for any make and model through a simple API plus hardware backpack, SDKs, and tooling
premises.evidence_span: developers can build applications for the connected car, regardless of their make and model, because we simplified the complicated car into a simple API call

premises.text: Hundreds of millions of vehicles in major markets form a large connected-car opportunity developers previously could not build for
premises.evidence_span: more than 400 million vehicles of which developers could not build applications for

value.text: A connected-car platform that makes existing cars smarter with apps and services for consumers, fleets, and developers
value.evidence_span: VINLY is a connected car platform that enables building applications and services for your car

causal_links.evidence_span: What about more than one billion vehicles on the road right now
download the Vinly app catalog and start using apps right away
developers can build applications for the connected car, regardless of their make and model
we wanted to enable developers to get a huge piece of this market

notes: Safety/money/fun app list folded as day-one catalog facets of the device/platform mechanism (§4.1.7). Developer API/backpack/SDK cascade folded into one developer-platform premise. Enterprise fleet kept with consumer product as same device offering with separate pricing detail. Traction (developers signed up, apps submitted) and Disrupt prize excluded (§4.2). Singleton D1/D3/D4 retained as separately revisable problem, developer module, and market claims. Anti-template: four domains, not need/product/money.
